── MARISOL'S WEEK ──
Marisol is training for a second marathon, the Wexley Lakes Marathon, aiming to break 3:45 after a 4:02 debut. Marisol runs five days a week, with a session on Wednesday, the long run on Sunday and Monday and Friday off, and ran about 30 miles a week before this build.
Recent weeks: 27, 37, 53, 40 mi
This week: 42 mi over 5 runs.
Feeling: "Anxious about the new date."
Asks: "The race got moved two weeks earlier, to October 18, because of the bridge works. That's three weeks from today. I've only done one 20. Do I still have time for my 22-miler?"

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Marisol: The taper starts now, so no 22-miler; you have enough long work in the bank, and the next two weeks are about sharpening for Oct…
Answers: (1) No, and I would not want you to try. You are 20 days from the start line, which is squarely in taper territory. (2) Here is what you actually have in the bank: a 20-miler three weeks ago, a 17 last week at 9:59/mi with only +4.7 bpm of drift, and five straight weeks… (3) Trust the taper. …
Next week:
Mon: rest. Full day off to start the taper clean after a solid 42-mile week.
Tue: easy, 6 mi, heart rate under 145, flat route. Loosen the legs; nothing more.
Wed: quality, 8 mi with 2 mi warm-up then 4 mi at marathon pace 8:35/mi then 2 mi…
Thu: easy, 5 mi, heart rate under 145. Recovery from Wednesday, keep it conversational.
Fri: rest. Protect Sunday.
Sat: easy, 4 mi, with 4 x 20 sec strides after. Keeps the legs sharp without any cost.
Sun: long, 14 mi, first 11 easy around 9:55/mi then last 3 at marathon pace 8:35/mi…
